title: Hobbies & Free Time
description: IELTS Speaking Part 1 · Sở thích và thời gian rảnh

questions.question: What do you usually do in your free time?

followUps.reason: Why do you enjoy that activity?
followUps.example: Can you describe a recent time you did it?
followUps.detail: Who do you usually do it with, and how often?

questions.question: Do you prefer spending your free time alone or with friends?

followUps.reason: Why does that suit your personality?
followUps.example: Can you think of a recent example?
followUps.detail: Does your preference change at weekends?

questions.question: Did you have the same hobbies when you were younger?

followUps.reason: Why have your interests changed or stayed the same?
followUps.example: What is one hobby you enjoyed as a child?
followUps.detail: How is that different from what you enjoy now?

questions.question: Would you like to try a new hobby in the future?

followUps.reason: Why would you like to try it?
followUps.example: What would be your first step?
followUps.detail: Where or with whom would you try it?
